June 22, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Kessler Investment Group Llc decreased its stake in Cummins Inc (CMI) by 98.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kessler Investment Group Llc sold 18,585 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.62% with the market. The institutional investor held 200 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $32,000, down from 18,785 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kessler Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Cummins Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $22.54 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.47% or $1.99 during the last trading session, reaching $137.23. About 429,992 shares traded. Cummins Inc. (NYSE:CMI) has declined 5.98% since June 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.55% the S&P500.
